steps.input:
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for color in sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0, 1)}):
        sr, sc = next((r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v == color)
        best = None
        for size in (3,5,7):
            r0,c0=sr-size//2,sc-size//2
            if r0<0 or c0<0 or r0+size>h or c0+size>w: continue
            pat=tuple(tuple(int(grid[r][c]!=0) for c in range(c0,c0+size)) for r in range(r0,r0+size))
            if all(v for row in pat for v in row): continue
            hits=[]
            for y in range(h-size+1):
                for x in range(w-size+1):
                    if (y,x)==(r0,c0): continue
                    if all(pat[dy][dx]==int(grid[y+dy][x+dx]!=0) for dy in range(size) for dx in range(size)):
                        hits.append((y,x))
            if hits and (best is None or len(hits)>len(best[1])): best=(size,hits)
        if best:
            size,hits=best
            oy=ox=size//2
            for y,x in hits:
                if grid[y+oy][x+ox]==1: out[y+oy][x+ox]=color
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code,str(p),'exec'))
out=transform(grid)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,r)) for r in out))

code='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[row[:] for row in grid]; seeds=[]
    for color in sorted(v for row in grid for v in set(row) if v not in (0,1)):
        sr,sc=next((r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==color)
        opts=[]
        for n in range(3,min(h,w)+1):
            for y in range(max(0,sr-n+1),min(sr,h-n)+1):
                for x in range(max(0,sc-n+1),min(sc,w-n)+1):
                    if all(grid[r][c]!=0 for r in range(y,y+n) for c in range(x,x+n)):
                        opts.append((n,abs(y+(n-1)/2-sr)+abs(x+(n-1)/2-sc),y,x))
        n,_,_,_=max(opts,key=lambda a:(a[0],-a[1])) if opts else (3,0,0,0)
        seeds.append((color,sr,sc,n))
    for n in sorted({s[3] for s in seeds}):
        eligible=[s for s in seeds if s[3]==n]
        for y in range(h-n+1):
            for x in range(w-n+1):
                if not all(grid[r][c]!=0 for r in range(y,y+n) for c in range(x,x+n)): continue
                # Restrict to bounded square motifs rather than overlapping interiors of broad slabs.
                sides=[]
                sides.append(y==0 or any(grid[y-1][c]==0 for c in range(x,x+n)))
                sides.append(y+n==h or any(grid[y+n][c]==0 for c in range(x,x+n)))
                sides.append(x==0 or any(grid[r][x-1]==0 for r in range(y,y+n)))
                sides.append(x+n==w or any(grid[r][x+n]==0 for r in range(y,y+n)))
                if sum(sides)<3: continue
                cy,cx=y+(n-1)/2,x+(n-1)/2
                color=min(eligible,key=lambda s:(cy-s[1])**2+(cx-s[2])**2)[0]
                for r in range(y+1,y+n-1):
                    for c in range(x+1,x+n-1):
                        if grid[r][c]==1: out[r][c]=color
    return out
'''
